## 5. Documentation Standards

### 5.1 Format Requirements

- **File Format:** Markdown (.md) for all documentation
- **Location:** Organized in appropriate folders (docs/, design/, tests/, etc.)
- **Naming:** Use clear, descriptive names (UPPERCASE_WITH_UNDERSCORES.md)
- **Templates:** Use templates from [.github/templates/](.github/templates/)
- **Version Control:** All documents in Git

### 5.2 Content Requirements

All documents must include:
- [ ] Project name and ID
- [ ] Date and version
- [ ] Document owner
- [ ] Status
- [ ] Revision history
- [ ] Approval/sign-off section

### 5.3 Review Cycle

| Document Type | Review Frequency | Reviewer |
|---------------|------------------|----------|
| Requirements | Per phase milestone | Product Manager |
| Architecture | When architecture changes | Technical Architect |
| Test Plans | Before each test cycle | QA Engineer |
| Security Docs | Monthly | Security Engineer |
| Operational Docs | After each deployment | DevOps Engineer |
| User Docs | Before each release | Technical Writer |
